A kubectl-style registry of the git repositories on your machine.

A project is a registered git repository. Its manifest can declare where the repository should be:
the remote, the branch and a commit to hold it at.

Projects live in groups the way pods live in namespaces. The group is "default", or the one
SLIPWAY_GROUP or the group key sets, unless -n is given, and -A covers every group.

Resource types: projects (project, proj) and groups (group). Type words are case-insensitive.

Usage: slipway [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Basic Commands:
  get            Display one or many resources
  describe       Show details of one or many resources
  create         Create a resource by name
  apply          Apply a configuration to a resource by file name or stdin
  delete         Delete resources by type and name
  edit           Edit a resource from the default editor
  label          Update the labels on a resource
  explain        Get documentation for a resource

Repository Commands:
  fetch          Fetch from the remote of each project
  diff           Show where projects differ from their manifests
  sync           Fetch projects and fast-forward their branches
  rollout        Manage the rollout of a project

Settings Commands:
  config         Inspect the configuration in effect
  completion     Output shell completion code for the specified shell (bash, zsh, fish)
  man            Show the manual page of a command

Other Commands:
  api-resources  Print the supported resource types
  help           Help about any command
  version        Print the version of slipway

Options:
      --color[=<WHEN>]
          When to use color in the output; a bare --color means always.

          [possible values: auto, always, never]

  -n, --group <NAME>
          The group scope for this request.

      --config <PATH>
          Path to the configuration file.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

  -V, --version
          Print the version and exit.

Environment Variables:
  slipway man lists the other variables slipway reads, such as NO_COLOR.

  SLIPWAY_CONFIG           Path of the configuration file; overridden by --config.
  SLIPWAY_DATA_HOME        Directory holding the registry: group and project manifests.
  SLIPWAY_COLOR            Outranks the color key (see Configuration File); --color outranks both.
  SLIPWAY_THEME            Outranks the theme key (see Configuration File).
  SLIPWAY_EDITOR           Outranks the editor key (see Configuration File), VISUAL and EDITOR.
  SLIPWAY_GROUP            Outranks the group key (see Configuration File); --group outranks both.
  SLIPWAY_NETWORK_TIMEOUT  Outranks the networkTimeout key (see Configuration File).
  SLIPWAY_PARALLEL         Outranks the parallel key (see Configuration File).
  SLIPWAY_PROTOCOLS        Outranks the protocols key (see Configuration File); the names are
                           separated by colons, as in ssh:https.
  SLIPWAY_DEBUG            When non-empty, unexpected errors also print their class and backtrace.

Configuration File:
  $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/slipway/config.yaml, or the file --config or SLIPWAY_CONFIG names, sets these
  keys.

  color           When to color output: auto, always or never. Default: auto.
  editor          Command line of the editor that slipway edit opens.
  group           Group used when -n is not given. Default: default.
  networkTimeout  Seconds, from 1 to 86400, a git network command may run before it is killed with
                  the processes it started. Default: 60.
  parallel        How many git network commands run at once, from 1 to 16. Default: 4.
  protocols       Transports git may use in network commands, as a list; any other transport is
                  refused, and so are ext and fd. Add file for local mirrors. Default: ssh, https.
  theme           Color theme: dark or light. Default: dark.

Use "slipway <COMMAND> --help" for more information about a given command.
